title: 3rd Generation (3G) Environmental Sample Processor (ESP) Integration and Support Services
agency: COMMERCE, DEPARTMENT OF.NATIONAL OCEANIC AND ATMOSPHERIC ADMINISTRATION.DEPT OF COMMERCE NOAA
description_text: This is a notice of intent to award a noncompetitive contract action. The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), Acquisition and Grants Office (AGO), Western Acquisition Division (WAD) and the Oceanic and Atmospheric Research (OAR) Great Lakes Environmental Research Laboratory (GLERL) intends to award a noncompetitive contract action for 3rd Generation (3G) Environmental Sample Processor (ESP) integration and support services. Please see the attached document for the complete notice of intent.
